name: {{ .service }} · availability as seen by callers
description: Internal SLO measured from client spans of every caller. Owner: {{ .team }}. Consumers: {{ .consumers }}.

customSli.indicator:
fetch spans
| filter span.kind == "client" and server.address == "{{ .address }}"
| makeTimeseries { calls = count(), failed = countIf(isNotNull(error.type)) }
| fieldsAdd sli = 100 * (1 - failed[] / calls[])
